scan_coverage.note: Baseline evidence currently covers only LCA. Live execution across all 48 gateways requires provider API access/keys configured in GitHub secrets. Automated runtime must operate via GitHub Actions only without mock/fake endpoints.

World Airfares.message: A live direct round-trip baseline exists for LCA. Expanding to all 48 gateways requires an authorized World Airfares API key set as WORLD_AIRFARES_API_KEY secret in GitHub Actions.

Booking.com.message: A live family hotel baseline exists for Larnaca. Full destination coverage requires an official Booking.com Demand API key configured as BOOKING_COM_API_KEY secret in GitHub Actions.

eDreams.message: eDreams live bundle querying requires an authorized eDreams/Opodo API key (EDREAMS_API_KEY secret) in GitHub Actions.

BreckenWander.message: BreckenWander package integration requires authenticated partner access credentials (BRECKENWANDER_API_KEY secret) in GitHub Actions.

Skyscanner.message: Skyscanner live flight querying requires an official Skyscanner Travel API key (SKYSCANNER_API_KEY secret) in GitHub Actions.

Issta/Gulliver/Kishrey Teufa/Daka90/Eshe.message: No structured package API credentials configured. Requires direct B2B API contracts or official supplier feeds.
